title: Sopa de Lima
subtitle: Yucatan-style chicken and lime soup
excerpt: Sopa de lima is the signature soup of the Yucatan Peninsula: a light, fragrant chicken broth sharpened with lime and lifted with chilli and fresh coriander. It is traditionally served with fried tortilla strips floating on top; crispy strips of shallow-fried corn tortilla make the ideal garnish if you have them to hand.
sourceNotes: Sopa de lima is a Yucatecan speciality with pre-Columbian roots, the lime element introduced after Spanish contact. It is found throughout the Yucatan Peninsula and differs from other Mexican soups in its use of a small, aromatic lima citrus fruit rather than the sharper Persian lime common elsewhere.

content.text: Add the lime juice right at the end, away from the heat, so the flavour stays sharp. Lime juice that simmers in the pot loses its freshness quickly.

items.prepNote: 2 breasts, poached in the stock and shredded
juice of 2 stirred into the soup, 1 sliced into wedges to serve

content.text: Pour the chicken stock into the saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the chicken breasts and poach for 15 minutes until cooked through. Remove the chicken and shred it using two forks. Keep the stock on a low simmer.
Add the onion, garlic, and chilli-green to the simmering stock. Cook for 5 minutes until the onion softens.
Add the diced tomato, oregano, and a generous pinch of salt. Simmer for a further 5 minutes.
Return the shredded chicken to the pan. Stir in the lime juice and most of the coriander. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and more lime juice if needed.

Ladle into bowls and scatter the remaining coriander over the top. Serve with lime wedges on the side. If you have corn tortillas, cut 4 small ones into strips and shallow-fry in sunflower oil until crisp, then float them on top of each bowl as a garnish.

items.cause: Not enough lime juice, or added too early and the acidity has cooked off
items.fix: Add a fresh squeeze of lime just before serving. The brightness fades quickly with heat.

items.symptom: The chicken is dry and stringy
items.fix: Poach at a bare simmer rather than a rolling boil. The gentle heat keeps the breast moist and easier to shred.
